Cc: mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec alignment: VP/CTO intro & next steps

Hi Ethan / Lindsey —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about Acme Health's roadmap for embedding LLMs into your clinician-facing workflows. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Key objectives: reduce triage time for clinician notes, improve search/retrieval over internal knowledge base, and keep PHI isolated.
- Current blockers: procurement/security review (SOC2 artifacts), infra constraints around VPC peering, and exec alignment to approve pilot spend.

Next steps we discussed:
1) Technical deep dive / demo with your infra/ML platform team (60m) to validate integration and latency profiles.
2) Executive alignment call (VP-level + CTO) to unblock budget and pilot scope.
3) Share a mutual action plan and a draft SOW for procurement.

For the exec intro, would you be available for any of these slots next week?
- Tues 6/8 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 6/9 11:00–11:30 PT
- Thurs 6/10 09:00–09:30 PT

If none of those work, tell me two windows and I will coordinate. I attached a one-page mutual action plan for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0124

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap.

All sounds good on our side. Lindsey (our VP of Product) and I think an exec intro + a brief technical deep dive makes sense. For the exec intro, can you also include a short list of attendees and expected outcomes (so Lindsey can forward to the CTO)?

Of the times you suggested, Wed 6/9 11:00 PT works best for Lindsey and me. We’ll aim to have our CTO (Daniel Park) on that call as well, but he may only be able to join for the first 20–25 minutes.

For the technical deep dive, can we tentatively block Thurs 6/10 09:00 PT with your team and our infra lead (Jamal Ahmed)? If you need a different duration let us know — we expect to run through integration points and network requirements.

Also: please include the SOC2 artifact link and any notes on VPC/on-prem deployment options in the MAP.

Thanks —
